blocks.text: PROSPERIDAD, AGUSAN DEL SUR — Agusan del Sur 2nd District Rep. Adolph Edward “Eddiebong” Plaza scored Monday morning the “systematic breakdown” of the government to improve agricultural productivity through proper laboratory-tested soil application methods. In his keynote speech during the Capacity Building on Soil Health and Local Diagnostics attended by participants from different regions, Plaza claimed there was an institutional disconnect between national government offices and their rural counterparts.
